name: Elephantine petition to Bigvai, governor of Judah (Cowley 30)
description: Letter from Yedoniah and the priests of the Jewish garrison at Yeb (Elephantine) to Bigvai, governor of Judah, asking for the rebuilding of their temple destroyed three years earlier; names Johanan the high priest and the sons of Sanballat, governor of Samaria; dated 20 Marheshwan, 17th year of Darius (II).
